title: Cabergoline in Nonfunctioning Pituitary Adenomas
brief_summary: Clinically nonfunctioning pituitary adenoma remains the only pituitary tumor subtype for which no effective medical therapy is available or recommended. We will evaluate the use of cabergoline in a clinical trial, in order to define the efficacy of this treatment in nonfunctioning pituitary adenoma.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* presence of pituitary tumor rest at 6 months after neurosurgery
* absence of previous hormonal pituitary hypersecretion
* absence of previous radiotherapy and/or radiosurgery
* Histopathological exam showing pituitary adenoma

Exclusion Criteria:

* ACTH immunoexpression at histopathological exam
* presence of previous radiotherapy and/or radio surgery
* psychotic psychiatric disease
* moderate or severe alterations in cardiac valves
